proposal.reason: Main functional change is to contribution/review automation: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds module-command handling, role-aware requirements, invitation lifecycle and summary updates; .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py enforces Reviewer+Maintainer gate logic; .github/scripts/commit_message_squash.py ties preview publish/removal to review-gate state; and .github/workflows/{review-module,maintainer-approval,commit-message}.yml rewires trusted triggers and dispatch flow. These are workflow policy/process changes, not runtime/CI system behavior changes.
